MetadataUpdate.description:
Patch document for `PATCH /api/tracks/{id}/metadata`.

Every field is `Option<Option<T>>`: absent means "leave this tag alone",
`null` means "clear it". `ToSchema` flattens that to a plain nullable
optional, which is the right shape for a JSON patch body.

OkResponse.description: The uniform acknowledgement for mutations that return no data.

ok.description: Always `true`; failures come back as an [`ErrorResponse`] with a 4xx/5xx.

TrackLyrics.description: Stored lyrics for a track, if any.

lyrics.description: Embedded lyrics text (USLT / UNSYNCEDLYRICS, or synced when available).

lyrics_format.description:
`"lrc"` when the lyrics text carries `[mm:ss.xx]` timing lines, else
`"plain"`. Absent when there are no embedded lyrics.

info.description:
The Muorg music server HTTP API, shared by the desktop (Tauri), web and Android clients. Everything except `GET /api/health` and `GET /stream/{id}` requires an `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` header.

`GET /api/tracks` is paginated and defaults to 500 rows — a bare call returns the first page, not the catalog. Follow `X-Total-Count`.

post.description:
The URL comes from the caller, which makes this the server's one
caller-directed outbound request — see [`crate::urlguard`] for the guards
and why they are there. In short: the host must be on the allowlist, it
must not resolve anywhere internal, every redirect hop is re-checked, the
response must actually be an image, and the body is capped as it streams.

200.description: Base64 image plus its MIME type

400.description: URL rejected, unreachable, not an image, or too large
